name: error-path-leak
title: Error-path leak
fix_goal: The same cleanup rules must hold when any p101 call fails, not only on the happy path.
fix_steps: Run the lab and open the fault-walk artifacts for this case.
Find the first injected failure that leaks an already-acquired resource.
Move cleanup out of the success-only branch.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the error-path lab is fixed.
lesson: The happy path can be clean while an injected setup failure leaks partially acquired resources.
